symbols.name: log exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed real exponent to which the logarithm factor $\lg n$ is raised in a near-linear bound.
symbols.quote: Here $\Xi$ is a fixed real exponent, the power to which the logarithm factor is raised.

relations.quote: Near-linear time is built from the [Logarithm](logarithm.md) $\lg n$: it is the class of running times $O\big(n(\lg n)^{\Xi}\big)$, where $n$ is the input length.
